tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — warm, never stark white. About 60% of any layout.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that sit on paper or on the unity band.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet sections and tile backgrounds; relief between paper sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text and the mark. 14.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, eyebrows. 5.4:1 on paper; 4.8:1 on mist.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, the visible construction grid, card borders. Decorative only — never a control border.

tokens.name: unity
tokens.usage: The one accent: the slash in the mark, links, primary buttons, the selected state. 6.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: unity-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of unity.

tokens.name: on-unity
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a unity fill.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width color sections (facts, footer). Paired with on-band text.

tokens.name: band-hatch
tokens.usage: The diagonal hatch strip on a band; its lines run at the slash angle.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on band. 6.3:1 in light.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The slash and accent details on ink grounds only (7.1:1 on dark paper). Too weak on band (2.7:1) — there the mark goes all on-band. Never text on paper.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline.

styles.usage: A single figure in a facts band.

styles.sample: Research, design and build — then steady monthly care.

styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title, in stone or unity.
